# Synthetic Property Insurance Policy (Non-Real, Test Fixture)

This is a synthetic, non-real property insurance policy document created
solely to exercise the XO compiler's semantic extraction pipeline end to
end. It does not represent any real insurer's terms and must never be
treated as one.

## Policy Details

Partner Contact and8827461093 QUICKSURE BROKERS PRIVATE LIMITED

Region(E)

Renewal(s)

PlanOpted(Yes / No)

## Coverage Terms

Send a confirmation notice to the policyholder upon issuance of this policy.

Contact the claims department within 30 days of any loss event.

## Exclusions

Flood damage is excluded.

War and nuclear risk are not covered.

## Warranties

Warranted that a working smoke detector is installed on every floor.

Warranted that the property is not vacant for more than 60 consecutive days.

## Claim Assessment

If the claim assessment amount exceeds 5000, then reject the claim.

## General Terms

Subject to satisfactory proof of loss, the insurer will process the claim within 14 days.
